intro: Rat Catching is a local bounty quest in Loch Modan issued by Mountaineer Kadrell of Thelsamar. Tasked with driving back an infestation of tunnel rat kobolds encroaching upon the western foothills, adventurers must cull the pests and return with their ears to claim a reward.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We have a real infestation problem to the west. Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!
We want them eliminated. Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.
You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail, friend. How goes the rat catching?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!
Here's your reward, friend. Well done.
